description: Comment "Content" and I'll send you my full playbook 👇 What happens when you ask Claude to make you go viral? I tried this and got over 80 million views and 200,000 followers in the last 30 days. Here's how: Prompt 1: "Act as a viral content strategist. Study the top performing videos in my niche right now and break down the exact hooks, formats, and topics that are blowing up and explain why they work." Claude hands you the actual playbook for your niche. The results were honestly insane. Prompt 2: "Now analyze my most recent videos on my channels. Break down my voice, my pacing, and my best hooks, and tell me exactly what my winners have in common." Claude does a full deep dive on your channels. Here's the trick: Prompt 3: Type "/" and choose Skill Creator, then say: "Now take everything you just learned and build me a skill that writes content in my exact voice so everything sounds like me and never like AI." Claude builds you your own personal content skill trained on your actual videos. Prompt 4: "Now write me 30 days of scripts with a posting schedule built around when my audience is actually online." Every single script comes out sounding like you actually wrote it. #claude #ai #claudeprompts #contentcreation #viral
